description:
We’re a team of 6 students, who are curious about how the Earth changes and about the data that shows it. For NASA Space Apps we chose Dancing with SARs. Synthetic Aperture Radar sees through clouds, smoke, and darkness, so it can show floods, land movement, deforestation, and crop change that optical satellites miss.

Who we are
We come from [e.g. programming, data science, engineering, design, biology]. We like turning complicated data into tools people can use and understand.
